ko: \(c\ge0:\quad\text{increasing, no extrema};\quad c=0\text{ has a stationary inflection}\)
매개변수가 음의 큰 값이면 극값이 원점에서 멀어지고 높이의 절댓값이 커진다. 모든 곡선은 홀함수이다.
en: \(c\ge0:\quad\text{increasing, no extrema};\quad c=0\text{ has a stationary inflection}\)
Large negative parameters move the extrema farther from the origin and increase their absolute heights. Every curve is odd.

answer.ko: \(\text{Transition }c=0;\quad c\uparrow0\text{ merges the two extrema at the origin}\)
answer.en: \(\text{Transition }c=0;\quad c\uparrow0\text{ merges the two extrema at the origin}\)

ko: \(f_c^{\prime}=\frac{1+c\cos x}{(c+\cos x)^2},\quad f_c^{\prime\prime}=\frac{\sin x(2-c^2+c\cos x)}{(c+\cos x)^3}\)
\(|c|<1:\quad\cos x=-c\text{ gives two vertical poles per period};\quad f_c^{\prime}>0\text{ on each branch}\)
\(c=1:\ f=\tan(x/2);\quad c=-1:\ f=-\cot(x/2);\quad\text{one vertical pole per period}\)
\(|c|>1:\quad\text{no poles};\quad\cos x=-1/c\text{ gives extrema of heights }\pm1/\sqrt{c^2-1}\)
\(1<|c|<2:\quad\cos x=c-2/c\text{ adds two inflections per period}\)
\(|c|=2:\quad\text{the additional pair merges into a sine-zero inflection};\quad |c|>2:\text{ no additional pair}\)
모든 영 분모는 정의역에서 제외한다. 절댓값 일이하에서는 각 가지가 증가하지만 절댓값 일을 넘으면 파형 극값이 생긴다. 추가 변곡점은 절댓값 일과 이 사이에서만 따로 존재한다.
en: \(f_c^{\prime}=\frac{1+c\cos x}{(c+\cos x)^2},\quad f_c^{\prime\prime}=\frac{\sin x(2-c^2+c\cos x)}{(c+\cos x)^3}\)
\(|c|<1:\quad\cos x=-c\text{ gives two vertical poles per period};\quad f_c^{\prime}>0\text{ on each branch}\)
\(c=1:\ f=\tan(x/2);\quad c=-1:\ f=-\cot(x/2);\quad\text{one vertical pole per period}\)
\(|c|>1:\quad\text{no poles};\quad\cos x=-1/c\text{ gives extrema of heights }\pm1/\sqrt{c^2-1}\)
\(1<|c|<2:\quad\cos x=c-2/c\text{ adds two inflections per period}\)
\(|c|=2:\quad\text{the additional pair merges into a sine-zero inflection};\quad |c|>2:\text{ no additional pair}\)

All zero denominators are excluded. Branches increase when the absolute parameter is at most one; beyond one, smooth wave extrema appear. Extra inflections occur separately only between absolute parameters one and two.

answer.ko: \(\text{Shape transitions at }c=-2,-1,1,2\)
answer.en: \(\text{Shape transitions at }c=-2,-1,1,2\)

ko: \(\text{Inflections }(k\pi,ck\pi)\text{ for every }c;\quad c=\pm1\text{ makes alternate ones stationary}\)
영이 아닌 매개변수에서는 물결이 직선 경향 위에서 이동한다. 직선과의 차이는 사인이므로 그 직선은 엄밀한 점근선은 아니다.
en: \(\text{Inflections }(k\pi,ck\pi)\text{ for every }c;\quad c=\pm1\text{ makes alternate ones stationary}\)
For nonzero parameter, the wave follows a linear trend. Its difference from that line is sine, so the line is not a strict asymptote.

answer.ko: \(\text{Extremum transitions }c=\pm1;\quad c=0\text{ is the periodic member}\)
answer.en: \(\text{Extremum transitions }c=\pm1;\quad c=0\text{ is the periodic member}\)
